scope: Reusable rules for names-only normalization of shared amenities and the separately applied, user-approved building eligibility filter for the Seattle apartment directory. Exact mappings implement consolidation, renaming, splitting and component exclusions; the documented eligibility policy governs a subsequent membership decision. Neither stage establishes new researched property facts.

execution.mapping_semantics: Each normalized source name maps to zero or more canonical feature labels. An empty array excludes that source from the main list. review_notes document unresolved name ambiguity. Policies explain how to review future additions; mappings are the executable decisions.
execution.source_field: amenities_original (created from amenities on the first run)
execution.detail_field: amenity_details.<canonical name>.source_descriptions; optional related_details for conditional, non-establishing context
execution.detail_attachments: Exact normalized source keys with attach_to_if_present and a note; attachments are evaluated after facility mappings and never create labels.
execution.building_eligibility: The building_eligibility section documents the separate directory-filtering stage. generation-rules/process_amenities.py normalizes labels and preserves building membership; it does not automatically execute this eligibility filter.

review_guidance_order: Explicit user-approved decisions in full_amenity_audit_review (including rejected renames and conditional detail folds)
Explicit approved renames and merges in compact_label_review
rule_precedence.specific_over_general: Specific approved omissions, folds and renames take precedence over broad guidance to retain creative spaces, services, games or fitness programs. Reflect approved changes in the exact mappings before running the processor.
rule_precedence.unknown_input: An unrecognized source name stops processing before writes; general guidance is not an automatic keyword or fuzzy-matching fallback.
rule_precedence.eligibility_stage: Apply building_eligibility only after splitting, exclusions, canonical naming and per-building deduplication are complete.

policies.rule: Normalize case, whitespace and trailing periods; identify distinct explicitly named functions before removing components; canonicalize functions; exclude low-value components; deduplicate canonical labels within each building. Exact reviewed mappings implement these decisions.

Never discard an entire compound because it includes an excluded component. Preserve the lounge, kitchen, parking, charging, games, etc. surrounding Wi-Fi, ordinary TVs, furniture, or access-control language.

Labels describe useful functions, not a count of separate rooms. Preserve shared-space relationships through each label's original source description. A shared yoga/spin studio stays one shared studio label. Never sum label counts as an amenity score.

Consolidate clear synonyms and spelling/plural variants. Slashes or the word and do not automatically imply multiple functions: hot tub/spa, barbecue/grill, and clubhouse/community lounge are single functions.

Never infer an outdoor rooftop from sky lounge, a full kitchen from kitchenette/appliances, a spin studio from exercise bikes, a theater from a TV, charging from EV-ready parking, gardening plots from decorative gardens, secure bike storage from racks, or an on-site facility from an external partnership.

Separately name explicit useful functions such as lounge/kitchen/games; terrace/grills/fire pit/pizza oven; coworking/meeting/private workspace; gym/studios/sauna; pool/hot tub/cold plunge; dog run/wash; bike storage/repair/wash; garage/guest parking/EV charging; package lockers/room/refrigeration; kayaks/paddleboards/shared bikes; sports court/climbing wall; dining/catering kitchen. The approved rare_amenity_review keeps minor components, equipment and programs as details instead of separate labels.

Do not create facility labels for ordinary equipment, furniture or incidental appliances. Free weights, exercise bikes, TRX equipment, ordinary TVs, chairs, mini-fridges, hydration dispensers and incidental coffee machines are details. DJ booths, stages, locker rooms and the other approved rare-review components also remain details. Explicit coffee bars and distinctive games remain amenities; Skee-Ball is included under Arcade games.

Preserve rooftop vs ground-level outdoor space, indoor lounge vs outdoor deck, pet relief vs dog run vs indoor play, bike parking vs storage, kitchen vs kitchenette. EV readiness is a Parking detail, never installed EV charging. Indoor/outdoor, heated, seasonal, rooftop pool and similar qualifiers remain attached in source descriptions. Do not add generic parent and specialized labels for the same facility.

Retain parking, EV charging, storage, bike facilities, package facilities, laundry, concierge and guest suites, even if paid. Retain explicitly named distinctive recreation, watercraft, kitchens, wellness facilities, gardens, workspaces and creative rooms with an explicit resident use/function, games and sports. Vague Creative studio and Workspace (unspecified) labels remain withheld under the specific rare-amenity decisions. Retain Fitness classes; Personal training, Cooking events and Nutrition consultations remain source/program details under the approved rare_amenity_review. Keep Doorman and Dry cleaning service. Tools to borrow are Tool lending.

Preserve all original descriptions verbatim. Paid, seasonal, 24/7, reservable, off-site/shared-property access, availability, quantities, brands, sizes, views and restrictions stay with the original source. amenity_details.source_descriptions supports the label; optional related_details preserves associated context without establishing the parent or transferring qualifiers such as lobby-staffing hours to concierge service.

Preserve source wording and add a review note without research or unsupported upgrades. Use the plain labels Spa, Pet spa, Pet area and EV parking without appending (unspecified). Preserve uncertainty in review notes and original descriptions; EV parking does not establish EV charging. Sky lounge becomes a resident lounge with no rooftop inference; a bare kitchen has unspecified equipment. Withhold the vague studios, workspaces, repair/access claims explicitly listed in rare_amenity_review from main facility labels; their original descriptions and caveats remain.

Deduplicate canonical names across all source entries per building. Retain all distinct source descriptions supporting the label. Multiple lounges or grills do not create repeated labels; explicitly stated quantities stay in their descriptions.

Keep normalization and membership filtering separate. After canonicalization and deduplication, apply building_eligibility: normally require at least two distinct retained labels; retain a single Gym (including source gym synonyms), and archive singletons with any other label. Zero-label results are flagged for separate inclusion review. generation-rules/process_amenities.py itself preserves every building and all unrelated data.

Use exact reviewed normalized-name mappings. Unknown inputs stop processing before writes; they are not guessed, silently omitted, or accepted as a new canonical category. Extend mappings and, only when needed, canonical_amenities; then rerun the processor.

Follow rare_amenity_review for approved omissions, folds and renames. A minor detail may attach only to an independently established parent amenity. Never infer a fitness center from a locker room, a sauna from a plunge shower, a lounge from a stage, or concierge service from a staffed lobby.

Use the approved compact_label_review renames and category merges. Gym covers general fitness centers and fitness studios without promising particular equipment; activity-specific studios remain separate. Movie theater combines theaters, media lounges and screening areas without promising a dedicated room or cinema equipment; Outdoor movie screen remains separate. Parking includes garage parking; retain garage type, equipment, shared-space relationships and service arrangements in original descriptions. Bike repair is a facility category, not a promise of staffed repair service. Pet wash station, Dry cleaning service and Valet trash service retain their names. Outdoor dining area is folded into BBQ details. Retain explicit grills as BBQs; attach dining-only descriptions to independently established BBQs without inferring grills from seating. Shared dining area is folded into independently established Shared kitchen details; never infer a kitchen from dining seating alone. Shared kitchen includes catering and demonstration kitchens; preserve equipment, kitchen type, booking and access restrictions in source descriptions. Parking includes covered parking and carports. Climbing wall includes bouldering walls. Coworking includes business centers without promising particular equipment, meeting rooms or private offices. Sauna includes steam rooms; retain dry-heat versus steam facilities in original descriptions, without implying both are available.

building_eligibility.evaluation_stage: After amenity normalization and per-building deduplication
building_eligibility.count_basis: Number of distinct retained canonical feature labels, excluding original descriptions, related details and withheld labels. This eligibility threshold is not an amenity score or count of physical rooms.
building_eligibility.exception_matching: Evaluate canonical Gym after the approved merger of general fitness centers and fitness studios. Activity-specific studios, ambiguous gym access and external partnerships do not establish Gym. This rename does not reapply membership filtering or reinstate archived buildings.

decisions.condition: Two or more distinct retained canonical amenities
decisions.action: Retain, subject to the other directory eligibility criteria

decisions.condition: Exactly one retained canonical amenity, and it is Gym
Exactly one retained canonical amenity, and it is not Gym
decisions.action: Exclude from the active directory and archive its full record
Flag for a separate inclusion review; the names-only processor does not delete it automatically

building_eligibility.previously_excluded_buildings: Before adding or merging any building into apartments.json, check generation-rules/excluded-apartments.json by id, current or previous name, address and property website. Do not automatically re-add a matching building, including under a new name or ID. Reinstatement requires an explicit user decision and a documented update to this registry; newly found prices or amenities alone do not override the exclusion.

Apply these explicit semantic decisions to all future reviewed mappings. Current label references reflect subsequent approved renames and merges; inventory_change remains the historical review count. Later full_amenity_audit_review decisions supersede this historical review where they differ; original decisions and counts are preserved here.
